description: This file is the main application shell for a Smart TV Weather app built using LightningJS. It sets up the application with plugins, a global store, a template for rendering, and route configuration for navigation between pages.

methods.name: Blits.Application
methods.description: Initializes the LightningJS application with configuration such as plugins, store, template, and routes.

methods.name: Theme.plugin
methods.description: Exports the theme plugin used within the application for theme management.
